metro:
FINANCIAL CASE FOR ASU/PHOENIX:
• Arizona state income tax: 2.5%–4.5% (one of the lowest in the West)
• No inheritance tax, no estate tax
• Median rent $852–$1,061 for 1BR — manageable on $65k+ salary
• ASU faculty salary range: $55,000–$85,000 for lecturer/instructor roles, $70,000–$110,000 for tenure-track
• ASU is the largest public university in the US (125,000+ students) — institutional stability
• ASU has a robust Black cultural infrastructure: Herberger Institute for Design and the Arts, multicultural programs
• Kenneth D. Cobbs (GWU Black House alum) is currently at ASU — insider network access
• NACA homebuying: Phoenix median home $445k but ASU employee benefits include housing programs
• Your MFA from GWU Corcoran + acoustic sovereignty research + OneBeat = genuinely competitive for ASU roles in social practice, sound art, or student affairs leadership
• Desert climate: no winter. Memphis/South roots = cultural adjustment possible. Phoenix Black population ~7% but growing rapidly.
